source_state: Dirty worktree; current owner and runner SHA-256 values bind this focused rerun to the tested snapshot.

shared_vm_run.command: cargo run --profile iteration -p quench-node-test --bin run-parallel-next -- --filter test-console-log-
shared_vm_run.build_profile: iteration; behavior qualification only, no performance claim

local_node_oracle.command: Run each byte-identical fixture copy as adjacent .cjs with NODE_SKIP_FLAG_CHECK=1; root package.json otherwise classifies upstream .js fixtures as ES modules.

cases.obligation: new Console({ stdout }) accepts the caller-owned Writable and log does not throw when its _write callback path throws null.
Console logging through the caller-owned Writable with a failing writev does not emit the forbidden process warning.

representation.aliases: console and node:console map to one BuiltinModule::Console and canonical cache key console.
representation.class: The shared module creates its default instance and Console export from the existing CONSOLE_CLASS source; no second Console class or output subsystem is introduced.
representation.stream_error: The selected stream path owns the thrown-null completion behavior. Console does not add a broad exception-swallowing rule.

limits: This qualifies the two included Console logging fixtures on shared NodeHost. It does not qualify global console installation, formatting options, other Console methods, or the full implemented Node inventory.
